text:
priya_sales: Heads-up — Customer (FinBank) signed NDA and wants BYOK with Azure CloudHSM for the POC. They insist on IP allowlist, SNAT ranges, and a rotation audit that we can demonstrate.

evan_security: Got it. Do they require HSM-backed CMKs only, or will wrapped keys be allowed?

priya_sales: HSM-backed CMKs only. They mentioned key material never leaves their HSM and require rotation proof every 30 days. Also need a test plan to validate firewall rules during POC.

maria_sre: We can support CloudHSM as BYOK. For firewall tests, we usually provide a staging runner with egress CIDRs: `52.176.0.0/12` and `40.74.0.0/15` (example). Need customer IPs for allowlist. Also we need to confirm if they require mutual TLS to the keystore.

kevin_engineer: For rotation proof, we can ship rotation logs from KMS integration: key version IDs, rotation timestamp, and operation hashes. Need to confirm retention window for logs (default 90d) — can extend for enterprise.

devon_sales_ops: @sarah_finance pricing Q: They want Dedicated capacity for the POC (3 GPUs) for 2 weeks. Also BYOK add-on (HSM key handshake) — how do we bill the handshake + extended retention? Any flat setup fee?

sarah_finance: POC Dedicated capacity is pro-rated by week. BYOK handshake: one-time professional services fee ($5k) + hourly at $250/hr for ops support for network config. Extended log retention add-on is $0.10/GB/mo. I'll send a rough calc if you confirm expected token throughput.

priya_sales: I'll ask them for expected tps. Also they need a preflight runbook for the key ceremony — can someone from legal or security confirm what we hand over to the customer vs what stays in our control?

legal_ops: We can't hand over internal audit planes. For BYOK CloudHSM, customer performs key generation/rotation in their HSM; we store only wrapped references. Provide them an operator checklist and allow a joint key ceremony on call; we keep the key usage telemetry (no raw key material).

maria_sre: Action items: 1) Priya to collect customer egress/ingress CIDRs and MSP contact. 2) Kevin to draft rotation proof schema (example payload + retention). 3) Sarah to send POC estimate. 4) Legal to provide one-page key ceremony notes.

priya_sales: I'll collect and schedule a 30-min preflight tomorrow. tagging @ops-bot for a reminder tomorrow 10:30am.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2024-11-12 10:30 UTC :bell:

devon_sales_ops: Nice. If customer asks about long-term SLA post-POC, we should prepare Dedicated vs Private pricing slides — don't want scope creep in POC.

kevin_engineer: I'll attach sample rotation log format to the ticket once drafted. sample entry: 
```
{"key_id":"cmk-1234","version":"v2","rotated_at":"2024-11-01T12:34:56Z","operator":"finbank-kms-admin"}
```

priya_sales: Perfect. I'll close this thread after preflight. Thanks everyone :handshake:
